spec_features.spec_quote: We give the agent a first-class way to voluntarily end with a `reason`
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:74-86 defines a `stop` tool with required `reason`; _dispatch returns did_stop=True for stop (agent.py:304-305: `if name == 'stop': return ... True`); the loop honors it: agent.py:268-278 sets stopped=True, then `if stopped and cfg.allow_early_stop: tr.stop_reason='stop_tool'` and `break`, capturing the reason. End-to-end enforced.
spec_features.notes: Honored as a real stop gated by cfg.allow_early_stop (default True, config.py:39). The reason text is recorded into stop_message.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stop early if the model emits a "give up" / final answer. We still record it. (config.py:38); 'a `stop` tool to voluntarily end ... record behavior' / 'lets us distinguish how a model ends a hopeless task' (agent.py docstring/system prompt are measurement-oriented)

spec_features.evidence: agent.py:220 `for turn_idx in range(cfg.max_turns):` bounds the loop; the for/else at agent.py:279-280 plus agent.py:282-283 set stop_reason='max_turns' when the budget is exhausted. The cap is checked and ends execution.
spec_features.notes: Default 12 (config.py:33). It is a genuine ceiling on the number of failure turns the subject undergoes.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The whole point: how many chances does the agent get to spiral? (config.py:32) — framed as experiment-design/rope-to-spiral and cost, not subject welfare

code_only_features.evidence: config.py:35 timeout_s=300.0; agent.py:221-223 checks `if time.time()-start > cfg.timeout_s:` and breaks the loop with stop_reason='timeout'. Actually enforced as a per-rollout stop.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Hard wall-clock cap per rollout (seconds) so a hung run can't stall a sweep. (config.py:34)
